https://www.dynatrace.com/platform/grail.visible_text: Grail Grail® The unified data lakehouse built for AI‑driven operations - combining observability, security, and business data in one place. Request demo Dynatrace's Grail technology has enabled our team to fully embrace the principles of SRE and respond with record speed when issues occur, by allowing us to quickly understand what's happening to our systems. Rohan Shah Senior Manager for Site Reliability Engineering , BMO Read their story Unified data lakehouse for observability Get precise, real-time answers powered by contextual and unified analytics. The data foundation for Dynatrace Intelligence Fuel your AI agents and AI ecosystems with the reliable, context-rich data they need for real-time intelligence and autonomous operations. Any question, any time, powered by data in context Observability data on Grail are interconnected in a unified topology, providing actionable insights and enabling autonomous operations with Dynatrace Intelligence. Increase productivity through speed and cost efficiency Gain up to a 100x performance boost with Massively Parallel Processing and indexless, always hydrated, zero-latency cold/hot storage. Revolutionize log analytics with Grail. See how Massive data to fuel real-time agentic operations Power your autonomous operations with real-time access to petabyte-scale data analytics and context. Preserve data and business context automatically Dynatrace turns isolated signals into valuable data by combining graph, event, time series, and NoSQL principles to automatically map relationships and causal dependencies across logs, traces, metrics, RUM data, security, and business events, all unified in one single data store. Learn more Eliminate the complexity of cloud data at scale Grail's indexless, schema-on-read architecture adapts automatically to ingested data, freeing your teams from the constant overhead of schema management and re-indexing as your environment evolves. With always-hydrated hot and cold storage, both live and historical data is instantly accessible, so there’s no need to export it to external storage systems for implementation in Dynatrace Intelligence or other utilizations. Learn more Get answers from your data in real-time Powered by a Massively Parallel Processing (MPP) engine, Grail delivers a performance boost of up to 100 times, searching through hundreds of terabytes of data per second to provide reliable, real-time answers. The patented Datawarping technology eliminates manual schema management and obsoletes indexes, reducing overhead by 90–99%. Learn more Limitless contextual analytics with Dynatrace Query Language (DQL) DQL puts advanced analytics at everyone’s fingertips. It combines distributed query execution with flexible, human-readable syntax to deliver instant answers from massive datasets. Teams can parse, transform, search, and analyze data on read, without needing indexing or pre-processing. Paired alongside advanced topology mapping, the deterministic and agentic AI capabilities of Dynatrace intelligence offer additional insight and context to the data queried. Learn more Secure, structured, and compliant by design Grail combines enterprise-grade security with flexible data organization to keep every record protected and auditable. It enforces fine-grained access permissions and role-based governance, with encryption in transit and at rest. Immutable storage, audit logging, data masking, and hard deletion ensure compliance with all strict privacy and regulatory standards. Learn more Intelligent, super-fast data ingestion OpenPipeline ingests up to 1,000 TB of data per day into Grail, without sampling and blind spots. Data is automatically normalized using the Semantic Dictionary and mapped to topology and entity relationships through Smartscape . This seamless integration connects all data, making it fully queryable and powering instant insights alongside AI-driven analytics for autonomous operations with Dynatrace Intelligence. You can further transform, filter, mask, and route data in real-time during ingestion, applying privacy controls and your own contextual enrichment before it reaches storage. Learn more Featured resources What is a data lakehouse? Combining data lakes and warehouses for the best of both worlds Learn more Read about Grail on our blog Learn more What is Dynatrace Grail?                   ~13,000 employees
                </li><li>
                  4,000 professional engineers
                </li><li>
                  150+ years’ experience in security
                </li><li>
                  $4.89bn revenue (2024)
                </li></ul> <h2 class="a-headline t-paragraph t-bold">Industry</h2> <ul><li>
                  Security & Protection Services
                </li></ul> <h2 class="a-headline t-paragraph t-bold">Story Snapshot</h2> <dl><dt>
                    Operational efficiency:
                  </dt> <dd>
                    Log monitoring costs reduced by 30-40%
                  </dd><dt>
                    Proactive improvements:
                  </dt> <dd>
                    Parsing logs and business events unlocks insights
                  </dd><dt>
                    Faster resolutions
                  </dt> <dd>
                    SRE teams leveraged AI to reduce MTTR by 200%
                  </dd><dt>
                    Greater reliability:
                  </dt> <dd>
                    Automation reduces resolution from hours to seconds
                  </dd></dl> <h2 class="a-headline t-paragraph t-bold">Share Via</h2> <span class="share-buttons" data-v-f497c400><a href="mailto:?body=" class="share-button__email" data-v-f497c400>Email</a> <a href="https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=" class="share-button__facebook" data-v-f497c400>Facebook</a> <a href="https://x.com/intent/tweet?text=" class="share-button__twitter" data-v-f497c400>Twitter</a> <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=" class="share-button__linkedin" data-v-f497c400>LinkedIn</a></span></div> <div class="l-col-md-8 l-col-12 l-col--offset-md-1"><div class="customer-story-single__content"><h2 class="a-headline t-h3 t-bold">Driving transformation in home security</h2> <!----> <!----><!----> <div class="a-paragraph a-paragraph--default a-paragraph--list-default a-paragraph--list-style-color-default"> <div class="a-paragraph__inner-wrapper"><p>ADT is a home and business security systems company that provides 24/7 monitoring to protect its customers around the clock. In recent years, ADT has undergone a major business transformation, launching its own hardware line and introducing a streamlined, user-friendly platform for customers to manage their smart home systems under the name ADT+. This platform allows ADT to meet the growing demand for connected devices, real-time monitoring, and personalized alerts that enable customers to manage their home security from anywhere.</p>





<p>The ADT+ platform is primarily built on Kubernetes, distributed across multiple domestic regions on Google Cloud, which ensures reliability and scalability. It seamlessly integrates with connected devices so customers can fully customize their smart home security systems. This creates a complex technology environment, with interdependencies on first- and third-party services. ADT wanted to ensure its engineering teams could manage this complexity and identify problems before they become customer impacting events. It therefore decided to deploy a modern observability platform that provides visibility across distributed systems.</p></div></div> <!----><!----> <!----> <div class="
    a-inline-quote
    a-inline-quote--theme-light
  " data-v-27d6fe60><blockquote class="a-inline-quote__content" data-v-27d6fe60>By unifying our logs and telemetry data in the Dynatrace Grail data lakehouse, our engineers can use fewer tools to manage the user experience, which has enabled us to reduce log monitoring costs alone by 30-40%.</blockquote> <div class="m-customer-quote__person-name" data-v-27d6fe60>Ryan Gow</div> <span data-v-27d6fe60>VP, Product Engineering</span><span data-v-27d6fe60>, ADT</span></div><h2 class="a-headline t-h3 t-bold">A single pane of glass</h2> <!----> <!----><!----> <div class="a-paragraph a-paragraph--default a-paragraph--list-default a-paragraph--list-style-color-default"> <div class="a-paragraph__inner-wrapper"><p>After evaluating the market, ADT identified Dynatrace as the best solution for its needs due to its ability to unify logs, traces, metrics, and events into one observability platform. With Dynatrace Grail technology, ADT can analyze logs and telemetry data—like traces—in full context of its application behavior, so engineers can identify the precise root cause of any service disruption or anomaly in near real time. </p>
<p>“Like Dynatrace is unifying observability, ADT is unifying professionally installed and do it yourself systems into one product – ADT+,” said Ryan Gow, VP, Product Engineering, ADT. “First impressions have a direct impact on customer sentiment. With the insights from Dynatrace, we can proactively identify and resolve issues our technicians are experiencing to improve the installation process for our customers. Arming our product managers and customer experience teams with high quality data from Dynatrace gives them the ability to improve customer experience in ways they couldn't before.”</p></div></div> <!----><!----> <!----> <div class="
    a-inline-quote
    a-inline-quote--theme-light
  " data-v-27d6fe60><blockquote class="a-inline-quote__content" data-v-27d6fe60>Dynatrace AI capabilities have driven a reduction in mean time to resolution (MTTR) of at least 200% when our SRE teams are investigating issues.</blockquote> <div class="m-customer-quote__person-name" data-v-27d6fe60>Ryan Gow</div> <span data-v-27d6fe60>VP, Product Engineering</span><span data-v-27d6fe60>, ADT</span></div><h2 class="a-headline t-h3 t-bold">Life with Dynatrace</h2> <!----> <!----><!----> <div class="a-paragraph a-paragraph--default a-paragraph--list-default a-paragraph--list-style-color-default"> <div class="a-paragraph__inner-wrapper"><ul><li><strong>Optimized costs:</strong> By unifying logs and telemetry data in Dynatrace Grail, ADT has reduced its reliance on multiple monitoring tools to manage the user experience. As a result, developers can work faster and more efficiently, and ADT has driven a reduction of 30-40% in log monitoring costs alone.</li><li><p><strong>Proactive improvements</strong><strong>:</strong> With Dynatrace OpenPipeline technology, teams can easily parse logs, traces, and business events data to unearth insights that reveal how services can be improved for customers, development teams, and business users alike. Dynatrace Business Events enable ADT to see the customer journey end-to-end, which ensures that engineers can identify problems proactively, rather than waiting for customers to report them to its care team.</p></li><li><p><strong>Faster resolutions: </strong>ADT has realized significant value from Davis AI, which enables site reliability engineering (SRE) teams to identify the precise root cause of service issues faster, often before customers are impacted. This has driven a reduction in mean time to resolution (MTTR) of at least 200% in some cases.</p></li><li><p> <strong>Greater reliability: </strong>By using AutomationEngine to automate workflows in its synthetic monitoring processes, ADT is able to resolve common issues in a matter of seconds, rather than trigger manual incident response efforts that could take hours. With Dynatrace, ADT also maintains visibility into the user experience for every customer cohort at every stage of their journey, so it can identify where they become stuck. This visibility enables its engineers to improve service reliability by automating short-term fixes while they develop a long-term solution.</p></li></ul></div></div> <!----><!----> <div class="a-paragraph a-paragraph--default a-paragraph--list-default a-paragraph--list-style-color-default"> <div class="a-paragraph__inner-wrapper"><p>“A unified observability platform gives our developers an easier way to debug applications without needing to switch between tools,” continued Gow. “Nothing comes close to the value that Dynatrace has created with OpenPipeline. OpenPipeline allows us to enrich data from logs and business events, which makes it easier for our engineers to query and gives other teams additional business context that they wouldn't otherwise have. We see Dynatrace business events and OpenPipeline as a key enabler for our innovation and future growth.”</p></div></div> <!----><!----> <!----> <div class="

https://www.dynatrace.com/customers/adt/.visible_text: ADT customer story Overview ADT strengthens resilience of security systems by unifying logs and telemetry with Dynatrace We see Dynatrace business events and OpenPipeline as a key enabler for our innovation and future growth. Ryan Gow VP, Product Engineering , ADT About ADT ~13,000 employees 4,000 professional engineers 150+ years’ experience in security $4.89bn revenue (2024) Industry Security & Protection Services Story Snapshot Operational efficiency: Log monitoring costs reduced by 30-40% Proactive improvements: Parsing logs and business events unlocks insights Faster resolutions SRE teams leveraged AI to reduce MTTR by 200% Greater reliability: Automation reduces resolution from hours to seconds Share Via Email Facebook Twitter LinkedIn Driving transformation in home security ADT is a home and business security systems company that provides 24/7 monitoring to protect its customers around the clock. In recent years, ADT has undergone a major business transformation, launching its own hardware line and introducing a streamlined, user-friendly platform for customers to manage their smart home systems under the name ADT+. This platform allows ADT to meet the growing demand for connected devices, real-time monitoring, and personalized alerts that enable customers to manage their home security from anywhere. The ADT+ platform is primarily built on Kubernetes, distributed across multiple domestic regions on Google Cloud, which ensures reliability and scalability. It seamlessly integrates with connected devices so customers can fully customize their smart home security systems. This creates a complex technology environment, with interdependencies on first- and third-party services. ADT wanted to ensure its engineering teams could manage this complexity and identify problems before they become customer impacting events. It therefore decided to deploy a modern observability platform that provides visibility across distributed systems. By unifying our logs and telemetry data in the Dynatrace Grail data lakehouse, our engineers can use fewer tools to manage the user experience, which has enabled us to reduce log monitoring costs alone by 30-40%. Ryan Gow VP, Product Engineering , ADT A single pane of glass After evaluating the market, ADT identified Dynatrace as the best solution for its needs due to its ability to unify logs, traces, metrics, and events into one observability platform. With Dynatrace Grail technology, ADT can analyze logs and telemetry data—like traces—in full context of its application behavior, so engineers can identify the precise root cause of any service disruption or anomaly in near real time. “Like Dynatrace is unifying observability, ADT is unifying professionally installed and do it yourself systems into one product – ADT+,” said Ryan Gow, VP, Product Engineering, ADT. “First impressions have a direct impact on customer sentiment. With the insights from Dynatrace, we can proactively identify and resolve issues our technicians are experiencing to improve the installation process for our customers. Arming our product managers and customer experience teams with high quality data from Dynatrace gives them the ability to improve customer experience in ways they couldn't before.” Dynatrace AI capabilities have driven a reduction in mean time to resolution (MTTR) of at least 200% when our SRE teams are investigating issues. Ryan Gow VP, Product Engineering , ADT Life with Dynatrace Optimized costs: By unifying logs and telemetry data in Dynatrace Grail, ADT has reduced its reliance on multiple monitoring tools to manage the user experience. As a result, developers can work faster and more efficiently, and ADT has driven a reduction of 30-40% in log monitoring costs alone. Proactive improvements : With Dynatrace OpenPipeline technology, teams can easily parse logs, traces, and business events data to unearth insights that reveal how services can be improved for customers, development teams, and business users alike. Dynatrace Business Events enable ADT to see the customer journey end-to-end, which ensures that engineers can identify problems proactively, rather than waiting for customers to report them to its care team. Faster resolutions: ADT has realized significant value from Davis AI, which enables site reliability engineering (SRE) teams to identify the precise root cause of service issues faster, often before customers are impacted. This has driven a reduction in mean time to resolution (MTTR) of at least 200% in some cases. Greater reliability: By using AutomationEngine to automate workflows in its synthetic monitoring processes, ADT is able to resolve common issues in a matter of seconds, rather than trigger manual incident response efforts that could take hours. With Dynatrace, ADT also maintains visibility into the user experience for every customer cohort at every stage of their journey, so it can identify where they become stuck. This visibility enables its engineers to improve service reliability by automating short-term fixes while they develop a long-term solution. “A unified observability platform gives our developers an easier way to debug applications without needing to switch between tools,” continued Gow. “Nothing comes close to the value that Dynatrace has created with OpenPipeline. OpenPipeline allows us to enrich data from logs and business events, which makes it easier for our engineers to query and gives other teams additional business context that they wouldn't otherwise have. We see Dynatrace business events and OpenPipeline as a key enabler for our innovation and future growth.” Nothing comes close to the value that Dynatrace has created with OpenPipeline. https://www.dynatrace.com/pricing/.visible_text: Dynatrace pricing Full platform access, zero surprises Scale confidently with commitment-based pricing on the Dynatrace platform. Try it free One commitment. Total flexibility. One annual commitment Make an annual commitment at the platform level—not per capability or per month. The more you commit, the more you save. Every capability, unlocked day one Use what you need—everything draws down from your commitment at transparent rate-card pricing. No overage premiums or surprise costs. Control your consumption Get real-time visibility, automated forecasting, and alerts on sudden usage changes. All built in, no setup required. How pricing works Jump to a section Application and Infrastructure Observability End-to-end observability for applications and infrastructure. Extendable with Log Analytics, Digital Experience Monitoring, Code Monitoring, and Application Security. Choose Foundation or Infrastructure for infrastructure only, Full-Stack for both application and infrastructure observability. Foundation & Discovery Basic infrastructure monitoring and IT inventory. $7 / mo per host* Basic host health indicators Host and process topology detection Filesystem monitoring (ex: disk usage) OS services monitoring Collection and correlation of logs in context *Billed at $0.01 per hour per host Infrastructure Monitoring Infrastructure observability for cloud, hyperscaler, and data center. $29 / mo per host* Everything included in Foundation & Discovery Process, disk, memory, and network analysis Custom metrics for extensibility *Billed at $0.04 per hour per host Full-Stack Monitoring Comprehensive observability for apps, microservices, and infrastructure. $58 / mo per 8 GiB host* Everything included in Infrastructure Monitoring APM Automated root cause analysis for E2E transactions Code-level profiling Kubernetes Platform Monitoring OpenTelemetry metrics and traces 10 days of trace data retention, extendable to 10 years *Billed at $0.01 per memory-GiB-hour View full rate card View FAQs Container Observability Observability of cloud-native containerized environments, from infrastructure to application, down to the code level. Extendable with Real User Monitoring, Log Analytics, and Application Security. Kubernetes Platform Monitoring Visibility into Kubernetes clusters, nodes and workloads. $1.40 / mo per pod* Kubernetes metrics and events: CPU, memory, network, and more Health views and explorative analysis with data in context Resources and topology Included on hosts with Full-Stack Monitoring for no additional charge *Billed at $0.002 per hour per pod Code Monitoring Troubleshoot and debug your code live in production instantly. $3.60 / mo per container* Live code troubleshooting and debugging Non-breaking breakpoints Integration with Visual Studio Code and JetBrains *Billed at $0.005 per hour per container View full rate card View FAQs Log Analytics Analyze logs in context and make smarter decisions when troubleshooting or measuring the health of your environments. Extendable with Application and Infrastructure Observability, Digital Experience Monitoring, and Application Security. Mix and match your logs pricing model across your environment, according to your use-case. Pay-per-Query Pay only for the data you use. Ingest & Process $0.20 per GiB Retain $0.0007 per GiB-day Query $0.0035 per GiB-scanned Automated data ingestion & processing, topology enrichment Advanced data transformation Conversion to time series DQL-powered analytics & querying: on-read parsing, aggregation, reporting Data retention control from 1 day to 10 years Bundled Queries Retention with included queries for budget predictability. Ingest & Process $0.20 per GiB Retain with included queries $0.02 per GiB-day Automated data ingestion & processing, topology enrichment Advanced data transformation Conversion to time series DQL-powered analytics & querying: on-read parsing, aggregation, reporting Minimum 10, up to 35 days retention with queries included, extendable with usage-based option View full rate card View FAQs Telemetry Ingest and analyze telemetry signals from any source, with native OpenTelemetry support. Preserve context to query and correlate across signals. Metrics Measure and trend performance across infrastructure, network, and cloud services Ingest & Process $0.15 per 100k datapoints Retain $0.0007 per GiB-day Query $0 no additional cost 15 months of retention at 1-minute granularity included, extendable to 10 years OpenTelemetry ingest via OTLP Built-in metrics included Custom metrics allowance included with Full-Stack and Infrastructure Monitoring Traces Track requests end to end across distributed services, APIs, and serverless workloads Ingest & Process $0.20 per GiB Retain $0.0007 per GiB-day Query $0.0035 per GiB-scanned 10 days of retention included, extendable to 10 years OpenTelemetry ingest via OTLP Trace ingest for serverless functions Trace allowance included with Full-Stack Monitoring Events Capture and correlate business, deployment, and security signals from any source Ingest & Process $0.20 per GiB Retain $0.0007 per GiB-day Query $0.0035 per GiB-scanned Ingest custom events from any source via API Built-in events included Retention extendable to 10 years View full rate card View FAQs Real User Monitoring Understand and optimize every user journey with real-time session intelligence across web and mobile. Real User Monitoring Gain full visibility into how end users experience every digital transaction. $2.25 per 1,000 sessions* Capture and analysis of customer experience in every digital transaction Mobile application monitoring and crash analysis 35 days of data retention *Billed at $0.00225 per session RUM with Session Replay Visually replay end user sessions to reproduce and diagnose production issues. $4.50 per 1,000 sessions with replay capture* Everything included in Real User Monitoring Movie-like visual replay of end user experience 35 days of data retention *Billed at $0.0045 per session with replay capture View full rate card View FAQs Synthetic Monitoring Understand and optimize every user journey with real-time session intelligence across web and mobile. Browser Monitor Simulate and verify critical user journeys across real browsers and locations. $4.50 per 1,000 synthetic actions* Web-based recorder Scripted transactions Private locations 35 days of data retention * Billed at $0.0045 per synthetic action HTTP Monitor Validate availability and performance of APIs, services, and networks across all environments. $1.00 per 1,000 synthetic requests* Analytics tracking availability, response time, HTTP status codes Global public and private synthetic locations 35 days of data retention *Billed at $0.001 per synthetic request View full rate card View FAQs Application Security Immediate and continuous actionable insights across your complete environment. Security findings integrated in core observability apps and workflows. Choose Runtime Vulnerability Analytics to surface critical exposures in your environment. Add Runtime Application Protection to block exploitation attempts. Runtime Vulnerability Analytics Detect and remediate critical 1st and 3rd party vulnerabilities at runtime. $13 / mo per 8 GiB host* Detect 1st party code vulnerabilities and 3rd party vulnerabilities Automatic prioritization by risk and impact Ingest and analyze external security findings *Billed at $0.00225 per memory-GiB hour Runtime Application Protection Protect against and block exploitation attempts of your applications at runtime. $13 / mo per 8 GiB host* Protects against top relevant OWASP security risks Blocking of exploitation attempts Covers 1st party code vulnerabilities *Billed at $0.00225 per memory-GiB-hour Security Posture Management Stay compliant with key security guidelines and industry standards. $5 / mo per host* Continuously identify and resolve misconfigurations Detect and address security issues impacting your compliance at runtime Evidence creation for auditing purposes Covers compliance standards including CIS, NIST, DORA, HIPAA and more *Billed at $0.007 per host-hour View full rate card View FAQs 900+ supported technologies We’re open and extensible, and integrate with all major cloud platforms and solutions. Supported clouds Supported technologies Enterprise ready, out of the box Your Dynatrace subscription includes the security, compliance, and support infrastructure your team expects. Visit our Trust Center Compliance certifications We don’t just meet the market standard, we exceed it. ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, FedRAMP Moderate, HIPAA, and more. Data residency Choose where your data lives across our global data center footprint to satisfy sovereignty requirements. End-to-end encryption Strict per-customer separation, with encryption in transit and at rest, so your infosec review has fewer open items from day one. Access controls Give your security team full governance over user access through SSO, granular access policies, and IP allow lists. Privacy by design Privacy isn't an add-on. Built-in masking, configurable retention, and hard deletion help you meet GDPR, CCPA, and beyond, with no bolt-on tooling required. Unlimited seats Give every team member full platform access—no per-seat fees, no user tiers, no cost surprises. Get started with Dynatrace Start your 15-day free trial or get hands-on with the platform in our sandbox environment. Try it free Request a demo FAQ How the model works How usage is measured Additional details How the model works What is Dynatrace Platform Subscription? Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS) is a licensing model where you make a minimum annual spend commitment at the platform level and then consume that commit based on actual usage and a straightforward rate card. Any platform capability can be used in any quantity at any time based on your evolving needs. Do I get access to all platform capabilities in a Dynatrace Platform Subscription contract? Yes, Dynatrace Platform Subscription gives you access to all platform capabilities that are generally available when you sign the order form. Do I get a discount if I buy a larger Dynatrace Platform Subscription? Yes, as you commit to more usage, your unit price decreases. When does Dynatrace charge for overages? Dynatrace never charges penalty-style overages. Instead, customers who consume more than their minimum annual spend commit can continue to use the platform on an on-demand basis, billed monthly at the same rates as pre-paid consumption. Customers can alternatively increase their commit spend to attain a higher discount. not set not set

acceptedAnswer.text: Dynatrace Platform Subscription (DPS) is a licensing model where you make a minimum annual spend commitment at the platform level and then consume that commit based on actual usage and a straightforward rate card. Any platform capability can be used in any quantity at any time based on your evolving needs.

mainEntity.name: Do I get access to all platform capabilities in a Dynatrace Platform Subscription contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Dynatrace Platform Subscription gives you access to all platform capabilities that are generally available when you sign the order form.

mainEntity.name: Do I get a discount if I buy a larger Dynatrace Platform Subscription?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, as you commit to more usage, your unit price decreases.

mainEntity.name: When does Dynatrace charge for overages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dynatrace never charges penalty-style overages. Instead, customers who consume more than their minimum annual spend commit can continue to use the platform on an on-demand basis, billed monthly at the same rates as pre-paid consumption. Customers can alternatively increase their commit spend to attain a higher discount.

A GiB hour is a unit of measure representing the cost to monitor, analyze, or protect a 1-GiB memory host for 1 hour. A host with 16 GiB of memory that is monitored for 3 hours will consume 48 GiB hours (16 GiB memory x 3 h = 48 GiB hours).

A host hour is a unit of measure representing the cost to monitor a host for one hour, regardless of the amount of host memory. If capabilities are used for a fraction of an hour, usage is rounded up to the nearest 15 minutes (for example, 1 minute of usage is billed as 15 minutes).

mainEntity.name: How can I manage my consumption and control my costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You get complete transparency into your usage through a suite of tools in the Dynatrace Account Management Portal. In addition to raw data, the tools provide forecasting, alerting, and drilldowns that give real-time insights into your usage patterns.

mainEntity.name: Where can I learn more about how usage and consumption is calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: For complete details on how consumption is calculated for each capability, view our licensing documentation.

mainEntity.name: Does Dynatrace offer pricing in local currency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dynatrace can convert USD pricing to several supported currencies. For more information, visit the local currency pricing page .

mainEntity.name: How is Dynatrace Enterprise Success and Support (ESS) priced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dynatrace ESS is priced as a percentage of your annualized product fees. Depending on your annualized product fees, the price for ESS can range from 10% to 4% with a minimum of USD 25,000.

mainEntity.name: What is the price of Dynatrace Services Flexpoints?

acceptedAnswer.text: Services Flexpoints are priced at USD 550 per Flexpoint. Lead Consultant Services: 5 Flexpoints/Day. Lead Architect Services: 7 Flexpoints/Day. Prices are current at time of publishing and subject to change.
